name: train_spec_mordekaiser
description: Dispatch marker for the Mordekaiser specialist (riftlab.yml, request=lab/specs/train_spec_mordekaiser.json, chain=N): see train_spec_kennen.json. Trained on its own decisions with Mordekaiser against loop.SPECIALISTS['mordekaiser'] jury (piloted by the legends' specialists), with its legend's human RiftLite decisions weighted --spec-human-weight; ladder lab/learn/specialists/mordekaiser/. Jeremy's split (6 Nov): 8 of the 20 runners; 960 self-play games per iteration. 8 Nov (Jeremy): jury = the Stuttgart RC Europe field. 8 Nov 10:40 UTC (Jeremy): down to 4 runners. 8 Nov 18:00 UTC (Jeremy): 6 runners.
note: 13 Nov 22:40 UTC (Jeremy: 'entraînement sur Voli, Morde, Riven et Evelynn après ban', away for the weekend): post-ban track (loop._POSTBAN_TRACKS: lists and opponents without the banned cards, continuous mode, a net committed every 6 iterations), 4 of the 20 runners.
